digest.component_or_area: RP-01: Pydantic AI agent seam migration and behavioral preservation
propositions: Rebar's bespoke structured-output orchestration must migrate to Pydantic AI seams while preserving all hard-won deterministic repair, extraction, refusal/truncation, retry, budget, provider-fallback, usage-accounting, and telemetry behavior

Complete failed responses are sent on retry only when deterministic token-count fit is proven through count_tokens; otherwise the response is omitted whole from the retry context, never prefix-truncated, and authoritative input/output remain in full history

Successful output retries aggregate all consumed attempts into one operation-wide usage row and request-budget counter, intentionally changing current accepted-attempt-only projection to reflect truthful whole-run spend

Exhaustion of output-validation retries must re-raise only the exact Rebar-owned StructuredOutputError found in Pydantic's cause chain, never blanket-mapping UnexpectedModelBehavior; refusal and content-filter remain terminal after one call

Fallback and native-to-prompted candidate attempts do not increment core request count or enter pricing/UsageLimits; candidate observability is provided via trace/journal events through public model instrumentation, never via fabricated token usage
One operation-wide Pydantic request budget covers tool turns and output-validation retries combined, with a documented maintainer caveat to raise the limit if legitimate recovery is starved
